topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Oh no, I can't believe they cancelled your surprise party! That's just not right, after all the planning and excitement. I know how much you were looking forward to it, and I’m so sorry you’re feeling let down. Listen, why don’t we do something special, just the two of us? We can grab your favorite food, maybe rent that movie you’ve been eyeing, and just have a chill night together. You deserve a celebration, surprise or not, and I’m more than happy to make it happen. Let me know what you think, okay? You’re amazing, and no cancelled party can change that.
